guard: the Codex host awaits the real mesh connection before announcing ready or handing the terminal to the TUI

mutations.name: restore the fire-and-forget mesh launch that reports a disconnected Codex as ready
mutations.expectRed: the startup failure names mesh readiness and the unreachable broker
mutations.cell: the startup failure names mesh readiness and the unreachable broker

mutations.name: CONTROL the shutlaunch thread-start wait is live in its suite file
mutations.expectRed: a shutdown during the launch exits cleanly, not fatally
mutations.cell: a shutdown during the launch exits cleanly, not fatally
mutations.note: Positive control for the same-file reach requirement. It proves the suite still reaches the shutlaunch poll site by making the wait predicate resolve instantly with a bogus entry, so the shutdown lands before the thread is up and the named cell reds. (A never-resolving predicate was tried first: the waitFor timeout crashes this fail-fast suite before the cell prints, which the grader reports as WRONG-RED, not KILLED.)
